b.name: Moonleaf Herbs
b.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

b.name: Crystal Vial
b.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

b.name: Candlewick
b.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

b.name: Fresh Bread
b.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

b.name: Honey Pastry
b.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

b.name: Alden's Journal
b.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

b.name: Strange Cloth
b.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

b.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
b.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.
